items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: He’s kind of trying to do Orson Welles or something... But I mean that’s a pretty good model, Orson Welles.

ctx.x: He’s kind of trying to do Orson Welles or something, and he directed it. But I mean that’s a pretty good model, Orson Welles. But I thought maybe the critics thought it was too derivative you know, the things, the way he directed the thing. But it was certainly original, with all the music.
Well it’s interesting too I think now that we look at that we see him doing the “Dragnet” thing, and that colors the way we look at him.
